purpose: Deterministic multi-world conformance for Living Wiki over accepted native owner mains. The O:I commit under test is supplied by the workflow run/PR receipt rather than self-referentially embedded here.

central.role: source identity, revision, Source Change Horizon, Flow source authority

ai-kit.role: impact/freshness, integrative readings, explicit Contemplate, Flow standing context

software-factory.role: software Project developmental orientation and returned Run/product evidence

quaternal-logic.role: optional WikiFrame/refraction/Context Frame depth; ordinary Wiki correctness remains independent

worlds.name: minimal-ordinary-project
proves: direct/offline source changes reconcile into deterministic source revision truth
change/impact/freshness/pending queries perform zero automatic Agent/model invocation
changed basis is integration pressure rather than an automatic falsehood judgement
Contemplate is explicit and begins the intentional Agent line
human-authored Ground pressure returns as proposal/Recognition rather than automatic mutation
ordinary Living Knowledge remains complete with QL absent

worlds.name: software-project
proves: authored source, implementation, Run/evidence and Agent-Wiki returns retain distinct authority paths
Factory current-main developmental return composes through O:I without O:I owning Factory semantics
canonical AgentSession and Project/Flow identities survive provider/runtime rebinding
returned software evidence becomes owner-attributed knowledge input rather than human-authored Ground

worlds.name: deep-structured-knowledge-project
proves: transitive impact crosses several integrative-reading levels without eager recomputation
whole-to-part and part-to-integrating-reading traversal remains provenance-bearing
retained/adopted source placement outside ProjectCentral/user remains addressable by stable SourceRef
FlowRef relates to its native owner SourceRef without collapsing either identity
5→0→1 remains an entry aperture while 2/3/4/full relevant Context Frame stays recoverable
canonical Return remains distinct from the entry aperture
QL-derived readings are attributable/removable and never become canonical Wiki truth

global_invariants: filesystem watcher hints never replace Central reconciliation/source truth
source payloads are not exposed by the Source Change Horizon
no source/document change invokes Contemplate implicitly
Flow is source continuity, not a Wiki/store/session/run replacement
O:I consumes native owner contracts and does not create source watcher, Wiki engine, model-runtime or Agent semantics
no physical/local-machine acceptance evidence is claimed by W7
